name: World Hunger
overview: Scripture acknowledges the persistent reality of poverty and hunger, commanding believers to generously open their hands to those in need, as seen in Deuteronomy 15:11 and Proverbs 22:9. God is portrayed as a refuge and strength for the poor and afflicted (Isaiah 25:4), and believers are called to actively satisfy the hungry and afflicted, promising spiritual blessing and illumination in return (Isaiah 58:10). The hunger and thirst for righteousness, emphasized in Matthew 5:6, points to a deeper spiritual fulfillment that God provides to those who seek Him earnestly (Matthew 7:7).
